mapper.select: select distinct r.role_key from sys_role r inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = r.id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and r.status = 1 and r.deleted = 0

select distinct m.perms from sys_menu m inner join sys_role_menu rm on rm.menu_id = m.id inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = rm.role_id inner join sys_role r on r.id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and r.status = 1 and r.deleted = 0 and m.status = 1 and m.deleted = 0 and m.perms is not null and m.perms != ''
